subject: Air freight quotes from MUC to SGN and ICN
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you check the fastest air freight option for each of the two shipments below? Both will be ready on 2026-11-26, and we’ll deliver them to Munich airport (MUC) ourselves.

1. To SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN): automotive sensors, 6 pieces, gross weight 1592 kg, volume 6.77 cbm.
2. To ICN (Seoul, KR): printed marketing material, 7 pieces, gross weight 813 kg, volume 6.04 cbm.

Could you send both quotes in the same reply, with a separate all-in price in EUR for each shipment rather than a combined total?

Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting air freight options and separate quotes for two new shipments.
